summary:
Halfway to Mars, radio signals to Earth face a 3 to 22-minute speed-of-light delay, meaning flight surgeons in Houston cannot provide real-time emergency intervention. Because astronauts are not doctors, long-duration crews require an autonomous, non-technical medical workstation they can immediately trust.

Aura-med is an autonomous deep-space health workstation engineered for long-duration interplanetary missions. It pairs directly with an accessible commercial smartwatch (Oraimo Watch 2 Pro) over browser Web Bluetooth, decoding continuous pulse, step counts, and telemetry in real time, with seamless fallback to authenticated NASA flight data when hardware is offline.Grounded in the NASA Human Research Program (HRP) Evidence Books and NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR-379), Aura-med translates complex spaceflight biometrics—such as microgravity cephalic fluid shifts, hypercapnic CO2 scrubber failure, bone demineralization (Wolff's Law), and latent viral reactivations—into plain-language action guides with physical medical locker locations and step-by-step SOP checklists. Equipped with dual synchronized consoles for in-flight astronauts and Earth Ground Control, Aura-med delivers autonomous clinical decision support when Earth is 140 million miles away.
details:
1. WHAT IT DOES & HOW IT WORKS

Aura-med is a dual-dashboard autonomous health workstation engineered for deep-space interplanetary transit:

• Direct Smartwatch Ingestion: Connects directly to commercial consumer smartwatches (Oraimo Watch 2 Pro) via the browser's native Web Bluetooth API (navigator.bluetooth), decoding

proprietary SEWear Protobuf packets for continuous heart rate, live step counts, and SpO2 without requiring third-party cloud servers.

• Aura Autonomous Clinical Assistant: A clinical triage engine grounded 100% in authentic NASA flight data (NASA HRP Evidence Books and NASA OSDR-379). It provides empathetic,

step-by-step clinical guidance, pointing crew members to exact bulkhead locker numbers (Lockers 1–4) and linking directly to interactive emergency SOP checklists.

• Multi-Environment Adaptation: Dynamically recalibrates physiological baselines and atmospheric pressure thresholds across three environments: Spacecraft Transit (0.00g, 101.3 kPa),

Lunar Surface Base (0.16g, 70.3 kPa), and Mars EVA Surface Suit (0.38g, 29.6 kPa).

• Deep-Space Biomarkers & Viral Surveillance: Tracks latent viral shedding (EBV, VZV) and salivary immune biomarkers (Cortisol, CD4+/CD8+ T-cell ratio) based on NASA GeneLab studies

of astronaut immune dysregulation.

• Dual-Console Architecture: Features a crew-facing workstation optimized for low cognitive load and an Earth Mission Control console that simulates the real-world 3 to 22-minute

interplanetary communication delay.

2. BENEFITS & INTENDED IMPACT

• Resolves the Interplanetary Latency Problem: Bridges the 3–22 minute speed-of-light communication delay, enabling immediate life-saving decisions without waiting for Houston.

• Designed for Non-Doctors: Replaces confusing clinical jargon with plain-language diagnostic answers ("Has this happened?"), clear physical instructions, and direct bulkhead locker

inventories.

• Global & Terrestrial Relevance: Operates 100% offline with zero cloud dependency and integrates with budget $20–$30 consumer wearables, making it readily deployable for austere

telehealth, Antarctic research stations, submarine crews, and remote terrestrial clinics.

3. TOOLS, LANGUAGES, HARDWARE & SOFTWARE

• Frontend: React 19, Vite, Lucide React icons, Web Bluetooth API (GATT Core v5.2), Web BroadcastChannel API.

• Backend: Go 1.22 high-performance concurrent HTTP server, SQLite embedded database.

• Hardware: Oraimo Watch 2 Pro (BLE peripheral with proprietary SEWear 16186f00 Protobuf GATT service).

• 3D Biomechanics: Sketchfab WebGL interactive anatomical biometric viewport.

• Design System: Human-Centered Design for Extreme Environments (NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2), Emil Kowalski clean minimalist UX principles.

4. CREATIVITY & FACTORS CONSIDERED

• Zero-LLM Deterministic Reliability: In deep-space life-support scenarios, hallucinations can be fatal. Aura-med uses deterministic, fully auditable clinical logic mapped directly to

published NASA Human Research Roadmap protocols.

• Hardware Accessibility: Rather than assuming bespoke $50,000 aerospace medical hardware, we proved that off-the-shelf consumer wearables accessible to everyday citizens can be

reverse-engineered and integrated into mission-critical health monitors.

• Zero-Crash Fail-Safe Fallbacks: If the physical watch disconnects or an evaluator opens the site in an unsupported browser, the workstation smoothly falls back to simulated Artemis

crew vitals, ensuring continuous situational awareness.
